name: Milazzo (Italy)
description: Horizontal bicolour of red and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Milazzo (a black eagle on red beneath a tower) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Milazzo, a comune in Sicily; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Milazzo arms — black eagle on red beneath a tower, crowned, within branches
